title: Add a new shipping address on Suning and enter the recipient's name
instruction: On Suning, add a new shipping address and enter the recipient's name.

steps.thought: I'm currently on my device's home screen, and I don't immediately see the Suning icon. Therefore, my next logical step is to swipe left, as I anticipate it might be located on one of the subsequent screens containing my other applications.

The user wants to add a new shipping address on Suning and enter the recipient's name.
I am currently on the second page of the home screen.
I need to find the Suning app. It's not on this page.
I will swipe left again to go to the next page.

I see the Suning app icon (苏宁易购) on this page. It's in the second row, second column.
I will click on it to open the app.

The Suning app is open. I need to add a new shipping address.
Usually, this is done in the user profile or settings section.
I see "我的易购" (My Suning) at the bottom right corner. I will click on it.

I am now on the "My Suning" page.
I see an icon for "地址" (Address) at the top right, next to the settings icon.
I will click on the "地址" icon to manage shipping addresses.

I am on the "地址管理" (Address Management) page.
I see a button "+ 新增配送地址" (+ Add new shipping address) at the top right of the address list.
I will click on it to add a new address.

I am on the "新增地址" (Add New Address) page.
The user requested to "add a new shipping address and enter the recipient's name".
I need to click on the "收件人" (Recipient) input field, which currently says "请填写收件人姓名" (Please fill in the recipient's name).
Then I will type a name. Let's use "张三" (Zhang San) as a placeholder name.
The keyboard is up. I will type the recipient's name. Let's use "张三".

The recipient's name "张三" has been entered.
The user's request was to "add a new shipping address and enter the recipient's name".
I have successfully navigated to the add new address page and entered the recipient's name.
The task is complete. I will terminate the process.
